newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Swedish June unemployment to rise to 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Swedish June unemployment to rise to 9.1 pct.

text.p: Swedish unemployment was expected to rise to 9.1 percent in June from 7.8 percent in May, a poll by Reuters showed on Monday.
Forecasts ranged from 8.7 to 9.3 percent. The poll included responses from 14 analysts.
For 1997 the average of 12 analysts' forecasts was eight percent. Forecasts ranged from 7.4 to 8.5 percent.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish the actual June figure at 1100 GMT on July 11.

Economists who participated in this survey were from: Aragon, Consensus, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, IDEA., Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Paribas, S-E-Banken, Sparbanken, Transferator, UBS, Unibank and Ohman.
